sinopsis.es: Machado, colombiano radicado en Francia, regresa a Medellín para robar una esmeralda. Mientras ejecuta el plan, se enreda en una serie de eventos que lo llevan a reconsiderar su misión.
sinopsis.en: Machado, a Colombian living in France, is hired to return to his hometown of Medellín and steal an emerald. During the risky execution of his plan, he becomes entangled in a series of events that lead him to reconsider the ultimate goal of his mission.
